# @boostengine/ui Full API Specifications & AI Agent Handbook

> Version 2.1.6 | Universal React & Next.js Component Library
> Zero external CSS dependencies. AI Coding Agent Native.

---

## 1. Theming & Provider

### BoostProvider & useTheme
Wraps application with CSS variable tokens and provides theme mode switching (`light`, `dark`, `system`).
```tsx
import { BoostProvider, useTheme } from '@boostengine/ui';

function ThemeToggle() {
  const { resolvedMode, toggleMode } = useTheme();
  return (
    <button onClick={toggleMode}>
      Current Mode: {resolvedMode === 'dark' ? '🌙 Dark' : '☀️ Light'}
    </button>
  );
}

export default function Layout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <BoostProvider defaultPreset="neo-brutalism" defaultMode="system">
      <ThemeToggle />
      {children}
    </BoostProvider>
  );
}
```

**BoostProvider Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `defaultPreset` | `UIStylePreset` | `'minimal'` | Active design preset (`minimal`, `glassmorphism`, `neumorphism`, `neo-brutalism`, `dark-first`, `gradient-glow`, `material-you`) |
| `defaultMode` | `'light' \| 'dark' \| 'system'` | `'system'` | Initial theme mode |
| `tokens` | `ThemeTokens` | `{}` | Override light mode tokens |
| `darkTokens` | `ThemeTokens` | `{}` | Override dark mode tokens |
| `currency` | `string` | `'$'` | Default store currency |
| `locale` | `string` | `'en-US'` | Default formatting locale |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | required | App content |

### Multi-Style Preset System & PresetSwitcher
`@boostengine/ui` supports 7 built-in design presets:
- `minimal`: Clean, modern SaaS aesthetic with subtle borders and shadows.
- `glassmorphism`: Multi-layer frosted glass with `backdropFilter: blur(16px)` and translucent surfaces.
- `neumorphism`: Soft extruded dual shadows (`6px 6px 14px / -6px -6px 14px`).
- `neo-brutalism`: 3px solid black borders, hard 5px 5px 0px #000 drop shadows, 0px radius.
- `dark-first`: Midnight #0f172a / #090d16 surfaces with high-contrast borders and neon accents.
- `gradient-glow`: Neon auras, violet-indigo glows, and luminous accents (`rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35)`).
- `material-you`: Pebble curves (fixed 24px corner radius) and tonal pastel containers.

**Using PresetSwitcher:**
```tsx
import { PresetSwitcher } from '@boostengine/ui';

// Dropdown variant:
<PresetSwitcher variant="dropdown" />

// Floating pill variant:
<PresetSwitcher variant="floating" position="bottom-right" />
```

**Available CSS Variables (injected by BoostProvider):**
```css
--boost-primary       /* Primary brand color */
--boost-primary-hover /* Primary hover state */
--boost-bg            /* Page background */
--boost-surface       /* Card/panel surface */
--boost-text          /* Primary text */
--boost-text-muted    /* Secondary text */
--boost-border        /* Border color */
--boost-radius        /* Border radius */
--boost-font          /* Font family stack */
--boost-preset-radius /* Active preset border radius */
--boost-preset-shadow /* Active preset box shadow */
```

## 2. Utility Hooks

```tsx
import {
  useMediaQuery, useClickOutside, useDebounce,
  useLocalStorage, useWindowSize, useScrollPosition,
  usePrevious, useCopyToClipboard, useToggle,
  useIntersectionObserver
} from '@boostengine/ui';

// Responsive breakpoints
const isMobile = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)');
const isTablet = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 1024px)');

// Close dropdown on outside click
const ref = useClickOutside<HTMLDivElement>(() => setOpen(false));

// Debounce search input
const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
const debouncedSearch = useDebounce(search, 400);

// Persistent cart in localStorage
const [cart, setCart, clearCart] = useLocalStorage<CartItem[]>('cart', []);

// Scroll-aware navbar
const { scrollY } = useScrollPosition();
const isSticky = scrollY > 60;

// Fade-in on scroll with IntersectionObserver
const [sectionRef, isVisible] = useIntersectionObserver({ threshold: 0.1 });
<div ref={sectionRef} style={{ opacity: isVisible ? 1 : 0, transition: 'opacity 0.5s' }}>
  Animated Section
</div>

// Copy to clipboard
const { copy, copied } = useCopyToClipboard();
// Simple toggle
const [isOpen, toggle] = useToggle(false);

// Form state management with validation
const { values, errors, handleChange, handleSubmit, isSubmitting } = useForm({
  initialValues: { email: '', password: '' },
  validate: (v) => (!v.email.includes('@') ? { email: 'Invalid email' } : {}),
  onSubmit: async (v) => await login(v),
});
```

---

## 3. Utility Functions

```tsx
import {
  cn, formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatDate, formatRelativeTime,
  truncate, slugify, generateId, clamp, groupBy, getInitials,
  isValidEmail, isValidIndianPincode, isValidIndianMobile,
  debounce, deepMerge, omit, pick
} from '@boostengine/ui';

// Class merging (like clsx)
cn('btn', isActive && 'btn-active', disabled && 'opacity-50')
// => 'btn btn-active'

// Currency formatting
formatCurrency(1499)                    // => '₹1,499'
formatCurrency(49.99, 'USD', 'en-US')  // => '$49.99'

// Relative time
formatRelativeTime(new Date(Date.now() - 60000))  // => '1 minute ago'

// Slug for URLs
slugify('My Product Name (2026)')  // => 'my-product-name-2026'

// Initials for avatars
getInitials('Aarav Sharma')  // => 'AS'
getInitials('Priya')         // => 'P'

// Indian validations
isValidEmail('user@example.com')      // => true
isValidIndianPincode('110001')         // => true
isValidIndianMobile('9876543210')      // => true

// Number utilities
clamp(150, 0, 100)  // => 100
```

## 4. Layout Primitives (Lego Bricks)

### Box
Polymorphic component supporting `as="div" | "section" | "main" | "article" | ...` with shorthand spacing props.
```tsx
import { Box } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Box as="section" p={24} bg="var(--boost-surface)" borderRadius={12}>
  Content inside box
</Box>
```

### Flex & Stack (VStack, HStack)
```tsx
import { Flex, Stack, VStack, HStack, Button } from '@boostengine/ui';

<HStack spacing={12} align="center" justify="space-between">
  <span>Left Info</span>
  <Button size="sm">Action</Button>
</HStack>

<VStack spacing={16}>
  <Box>Item 1</Box>
  <Box>Item 2</Box>
</VStack>
```

### Grid & GridItem
```tsx
import { Grid, GridItem } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Grid cols={3} gap={24}>
  <GridItem colSpan={2}>Main Content</GridItem>
  <GridItem colSpan={1}>Sidebar</GridItem>
</Grid>
```

### Section & AspectRatio
```tsx
import { Section, AspectRatio } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Section maxWidth={1200} py={64} bg="#f8fafc">
  <AspectRatio ratio="16/9">
    <img src="/banner.jpg" alt="Hero" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
  </AspectRatio>
</Section>
```

### Motion
Zero-dependency entrance and scroll-triggered animations powered by native IntersectionObserver.
```tsx
import { Motion } from '@boostengine/ui';

// animations: fade-in | slide-up | slide-down | scale-in | slide-in-right | slide-in-left
<Motion animation="slide-up" delay={150} duration={600}>
  <h2>Animated Heading</h2>
</Motion>
```

## 5. Buttons & Actions

### Button
```tsx
import { Button } from '@boostengine/ui';

// Variants: primary | secondary | outline | ghost | destructive | link
// Sizes: sm | md | lg
<Button variant="primary" size="lg" isLoading={isSubmitting} fullWidth>
  Place Order
</Button>
<Button variant="outline" leftIcon={<Icon />}>Download Report</Button>
<Button variant="destructive" onClick={handleDelete}>Delete Account</Button>
```

**Props:** `variant`, `size`, `isLoading`, `loading`, `leftIcon`, `rightIcon`, `fullWidth`, + all standard `<button>` HTML attributes.

### IconButton
```tsx
import { IconButton } from '@boostengine/ui';

<IconButton icon={<SearchIcon />} aria-label="Search" shape="rounded" size="md" />
```

### ButtonGroup
```tsx
import { ButtonGroup, Button } from '@boostengine/ui';

<ButtonGroup>
  <Button variant="outline">Day</Button>
  <Button variant="outline">Week</Button>
  <Button variant="primary">Month</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
```

### CopyButton
```tsx
import { CopyButton } from '@boostengine/ui';

<CopyButton text="npm i @boostengine/ui" label="Copy Command" />
```

## 6. Forms & Inputs

### Input
```tsx
import { Input } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Input
  label="Email Address"
  type="email"
  placeholder="you@example.com"
  required
  error="Please enter a valid email"
  helperText="We'll never share your email."
/>
```

**Props:** `label`, `error`, `helperText`, `required`, `disabled`, + all `<input>` HTML attributes.

### Textarea
```tsx
import { Textarea } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Textarea
  label="Product Description"
  maxLength={500}
  showCount
  rows={4}
  placeholder="Describe your product..."
/>
```

### Select & MultiSelect
```tsx
import { Select, MultiSelect } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Select
  label="Category"
  options={[
    { value: 'electronics', label: 'Electronics' },
    { value: 'clothing', label: 'Clothing' },
  ]}
  onChange={(value) => setCategory(value)}
/>

<MultiSelect
  label="Tags"
  options={[{ value: 'sale', label: 'Sale' }, { value: 'new', label: 'New Arrival' }]}
  placeholder="Select tags..."
  onChange={(values) => setTags(values)}
/>
```

### OTPInput
```tsx
import { OTPInput } from '@boostengine/ui';

<OTPInput
  length={6}
  onComplete={(code) => verifyOTP(code)}
  autoFocus
/>
```

### FileDropzone
```tsx
import { FileDropzone } from '@boostengine/ui';

<FileDropzone
  maxSizeMB={25}
  accept={['image/*', 'application/pdf']}
  multiple
  onFilesSelected={(files) => handleUpload(files)}
/>
```

## 7. Feedback & Status

### Toast / useToast
```tsx
import { ToastProvider, useToast, Button } from '@boostengine/ui';

function ActionButton() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  return (
    <Button onClick={() => toast.success('Saved successfully!', 'Success')}>
      Save Settings
    </Button>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <ToastProvider position="bottom-right">
      <ActionButton />
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}
```

**Toast Methods:** `toast.success(msg, title?)`, `toast.error(msg, title?)`, `toast.warning(msg, title?)`, `toast.info(msg, title?)`
**ToastProvider positions:** `top-left | top-center | top-right | bottom-left | bottom-center | bottom-right`

### Alert
```tsx
import { Alert } from '@boostengine/ui';

// Variants: info | success | warning | error
<Alert variant="warning" title="Low Stock" onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  Only 3 items left in inventory.
</Alert>
```

### Skeleton
```tsx
import { Skeleton } from '@boostengine/ui';

// Variants: text | circle | rect
<Skeleton variant="rect" width="100%" height={200} borderRadius={8} />
<Skeleton variant="circle" width={40} height={40} />
<Skeleton variant="text" width="60%" />
```

### EmptyState & ErrorState
```tsx
import { EmptyState, ErrorState } from '@boostengine/ui';

<EmptyState
  title="No Orders Yet"
  description="Place your first order to get started."
  action={{ label: 'Browse Products', onClick: () => router.push('/shop') }}
/>

<ErrorState
  title="Failed to Load"
  description="Something went wrong. Please try again."
  onRetry={() => refetch()}
/>
```

## 8. Content & Display

### Card (Compound)
```tsx
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter, Button } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Order Summary</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Review your items before checkout</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>
    <p>3 items · ₹2,499</p>
  </CardContent>
  <CardFooter>
    <Button fullWidth>Proceed to Pay</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

### Avatar & AvatarGroup
```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from '@boostengine/ui';

<AvatarGroup max={4} size="md">
  <Avatar name="Aarav Sharma" src="/user1.jpg" />
  <Avatar name="Pooja Verma" src="/user2.jpg" />
  <Avatar name="Rohan Patel" />
  <Avatar name="Ananya Sen" />
  <Avatar name="Vikram Singh" />
</AvatarGroup>
```

### Badge & Tag
```tsx
import { Badge, Tag } from '@boostengine/ui';

// Badge variants: default | success | error | warning | info
<Badge variant="success">In Stock</Badge>
<Badge variant="error">Out of Stock</Badge>

// Tags are removable
<Tag onRemove={() => removeTag(id)}>Electronics</Tag>
```

### Accordion
```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Accordion
  items={[
    { id: '1', title: 'What is the return policy?', content: '30-day hassle-free returns.' },
    { id: '2', title: 'Do you offer EMI?', content: 'Yes, 0% EMI available on orders above ₹5,000.' }
  ]}
  allowMultiple={false}
/>
```

### Carousel
```tsx
import { Carousel } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Carousel
  items={[
    <img src="/banner1.jpg" alt="Sale" />,
    <img src="/banner2.jpg" alt="New Arrivals" />,
  ]}
  autoPlay
  interval={4000}
  showIndicators
/>
```

## 9. Overlays & Dialogs

### Modal / Dialog
```tsx
import { Modal } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Modal
  isOpen={isOpen}
  onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}
  title="Confirm Order"
  size="md"
>
  <p>Are you sure you want to place this order?</p>
</Modal>
```
**Sizes:** `sm | md | lg | xl | full`

### Drawer
```tsx
import { Drawer } from '@boostengine/ui';

// anchor: left | right | top | bottom
<Drawer isOpen={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} anchor="right" title="Filters">
  <FilterPanel />
</Drawer>
```

### CommandPalette
```tsx
import { CommandPalette } from '@boostengine/ui';

<CommandPalette
  isOpen={isOpen}
  onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}
  items={[
    { id: '1', label: 'View Orders', group: 'Navigation', onSelect: () => router.push('/orders') },
    { id: '2', label: 'New Product', shortcut: ['⌘', 'N'], onSelect: () => openModal() },
    { id: '3', label: 'Dark Mode', group: 'Settings', onSelect: toggleMode }
  ]}
/>
```
**Tip:** Open with `Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K` keyboard shortcut.

### Portal
SSR-safe React Portal for rendering modals, popovers, and overlays into document.body.
```tsx
import { Portal } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Portal>
  <div className="custom-overlay">Rendered directly into document.body</div>
</Portal>
```

## 10. Navigation

### Navbar
```tsx
import { Navbar } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Navbar
  brandName="BOOST STORE"
  links={[
    { label: 'Home', href: '/' },
    { label: 'Shop', href: '/shop' },
    { label: 'About', href: '/about' },
  ]}
  showSearch
  cartCount={3}
  onCartClick={() => setCartOpen(true)}
/>
```

### Sidebar
```tsx
import { Sidebar } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Sidebar
  isOpen={isOpen}
  onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}
  groups={[
    {
      label: 'Dashboard',
      items: [
        { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', href: '/dashboard', icon: <HomeIcon /> },
        { id: 'orders', label: 'Orders', href: '/orders', badge: '12' },
      ]
    }
  ]}
  activeItemId="overview"
/>
```

### Footer
```tsx
import { Footer } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Footer
  brandName="BOOST ENGINE"
  tagline="Build better, faster."
  columns={[
    { title: 'Products', links: [{ label: 'Features', href: '/features' }, { label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' }] },
    { title: 'Company', links: [{ label: 'About', href: '/about' }, { label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' }] },
  ]}
  showNewsletter
/>
```

### MobileBottomNav
```tsx
import { MobileBottomNav } from '@boostengine/ui';

<MobileBottomNav
  items={[
    { id: 'home', label: 'Home', href: '/', icon: <HomeIcon /> },
    { id: 'search', label: 'Search', href: '/search', icon: <SearchIcon /> },
    { id: 'cart', label: 'Cart', href: '/cart', icon: <CartIcon />, badge: 3 },
    { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', href: '/profile', icon: <UserIcon /> },
  ]}
  activeItemId="home"
/>
```

### Tabs & Stepper
```tsx
import { Tabs, Stepper } from '@boostengine/ui';

<Tabs
  tabs={[
    { id: 'desc', label: 'Description', content: <ProductDesc /> },
    { id: 'reviews', label: 'Reviews (42)', content: <ReviewsPanel /> },
    { id: 'specs', label: 'Specifications', content: <SpecsTable /> },
  ]}
  defaultActiveId="desc"
/>

<Stepper
  steps={[
    { id: 'cart', label: 'Cart', status: 'completed' },
    { id: 'address', label: 'Address', status: 'active' },
    { id: 'payment', label: 'Payment', status: 'pending' },
  ]}
  currentStepId="address"
/>
```

## 11. Data & Analytics

### DataTable
```tsx
import { DataTable } from '@boostengine/ui';

<DataTable
  columns={[
    { key: 'name', header: 'Product Name', sortable: true },
    { key: 'price', header: 'Price', sortable: true, render: (val) => `₹${val}` },
    { key: 'stock', header: 'Stock', render: (val) => <Badge variant={val > 0 ? 'success' : 'error'}>{val}</Badge> },
  ]}
  data={products}
  searchable
  pageSize={20}
/>
```

### KPIWidget
```tsx
import { KPIWidget } from '@boostengine/ui';

<KPIWidget
  title="Total Net Revenue"
  value="₹14,82,900"
  change={18.4}
  changePeriod="vs last month"
  prefix="₹"
/>
```

### ActivityFeed
```tsx
import { ActivityFeed } from '@boostengine/ui';

<ActivityFeed
  title="Recent Operations"
  items={[
    {
      id: '1',
      user: { name: 'Pooja Verma', role: 'Inventory Manager' },
      action: 'restocked',
      target: 'Silk Kurti (L)',
      timestamp: '10 minutes ago',
      statusBadge: { label: 'Inventory', variant: 'success' }
    }
  ]}
/>
```

### NotificationCenter
```tsx
import { NotificationCenter } from '@boostengine/ui';

<NotificationCenter
  notifications={[
    { id: '1', title: 'New order #1084', body: 'Order placed by Aarav Sharma', timestamp: '2m ago', read: false, type: 'order' },
    { id: '2', title: 'Server CPU normal', timestamp: '1h ago', read: true, type: 'system' }
  ]}
  onMarkAllAsRead={() => markAll()}
  onNotificationClick={(id) => router.push(`/orders/${id}`)}
/>
```

## 12. Authentication

### LoginForm
```tsx
import { LoginForm } from '@boostengine/ui';

<LoginForm
  onSubmit={async ({ email, password }) => {
    await signIn(email, password);
  }}
  onForgotPassword={() => router.push('/forgot-password')}
  onRegister={() => router.push('/register')}
  isLoading={isLoading}
  error={authError}
  brandName="BOOST STORE"
/>
```

### RegisterForm
```tsx
import { RegisterForm } from '@boostengine/ui';

<RegisterForm
  onSubmit={async (data) => {
    await createAccount(data);
  }}
  onLoginRedirect={() => router.push('/login')}
  isLoading={isLoading}
  requirePhone
  requireOTP
/>
```

## 14. E-Commerce & D2C Storefront Suite

### CartDrawer
```tsx
import { CartDrawer } from '@boostengine/ui';

<CartDrawer
  isOpen={cartOpen}
  onClose={() => setCartOpen(false)}
  items={[
    { id: '1', name: 'Silk Kurti', price: 1299, quantity: 1, image: '/kurti.jpg', variant: 'Blue / L' }
  ]}
  freeDeliveryThreshold={999}
  onUpdateQuantity={(id, qty) => updateItem(id, qty)}
  onRemoveItem={(id) => removeItem(id)}
  onCheckout={() => router.push('/checkout')}
/>
```

### ProductCard
```tsx
import { ProductCard } from '@boostengine/ui';

<ProductCard
  id="p1"
  name="Premium Silk Kurti"
  price={1299}
  mrp={2499}
  discountPercent={48}
  image="/kurti.jpg"
  rating={4.5}
  reviewCount={234}
  badge="Best Seller"
  onAddToCart={() => addToCart('p1')}
  onWishlist={() => toggleWishlist('p1')}
/>
```

### ProductGallery
```tsx
import { ProductGallery } from '@boostengine/ui';

<ProductGallery
  images={[
    { src: '/product-1.jpg', alt: 'Front View' },
    { src: '/product-2.jpg', alt: 'Side View' },
    { src: '/product-3.jpg', alt: 'Detail View' },
  ]}
  enableZoom
/>
```

### VariantSelector
```tsx
import { VariantSelector } from '@boostengine/ui';

<VariantSelector
  groups={[
    {
      id: 'color',
      label: 'Color',
      type: 'color',
      options: [
        { value: 'blue', label: 'Blue', colorCode: '#3b82f6', inStock: true },
        { value: 'red', label: 'Red', colorCode: '#ef4444', inStock: false },
      ]
    },
    {
      id: 'size',
      label: 'Size',
      type: 'button',
      options: [
        { value: 'S', label: 'S', inStock: true },
        { value: 'M', label: 'M', inStock: true },
        { value: 'L', label: 'L', inStock: true },
      ]
    }
  ]}
  onChange={(selected) => setVariants(selected)}
/>
```

### PincodeChecker
```tsx
import { PincodeChecker } from '@boostengine/ui';

<PincodeChecker
  onCheck={async (pincode) => {
    const result = await checkDelivery(pincode);
    return { deliverable: result.ok, codAvailable: result.cod, estimatedDays: result.days };
  }}
/>
```

### LightningDealsBar
```tsx
import { LightningDealsBar } from '@boostengine/ui';

<LightningDealsBar
  expiresAt={new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000)} // 3 hours from now
  claimedPercent={72}
  label="⚡ Lightning Deal ends in"
  onExpire={() => setDealExpired(true)}
/>
```

### OrderSummary
```tsx
import { OrderSummary } from '@boostengine/ui';

<OrderSummary
  items={[
    { name: 'Silk Kurti', price: 1299, quantity: 2, variant: 'Blue / L' }
  ]}
  subtotal={2598}
  discount={300}
  shipping={0}
  total={2298}
  couponApplied="BOOST10"
  onPlaceOrder={() => handleCheckout()}
/>
```

### eCommerce Storefront
```tsx
import {
  BoostProvider, ToastProvider, Navbar, CartDrawer, HeroSection,
  ProductCard, Grid, MobileBottomNav, Footer
} from '@boostengine/ui';

export default function StorePage() {
  const [cartOpen, setCartOpen] = useState(false);
  const [cartItems, setCartItems] = useState([]);

  return (
    <BoostProvider defaultMode="light">
      <ToastProvider position="top-center">
        <Navbar brandName="BOOST STORE" cartCount={cartItems.length} onCartClick={() => setCartOpen(true)} showSearch />
        <CartDrawer isOpen={cartOpen} onClose={() => setCartOpen(false)} items={cartItems} freeDeliveryThreshold={999} />
        <HeroSection badge="🔥 Sale Live" title="Up to 70% Off" description="Shop the biggest sale of the season." primaryAction={{ label: 'Shop Now' }} />
        <Grid cols={4} gap={24} style={{ padding: '40px 24px' }}>
          {products.map(p => (
            <ProductCard key={p.id} {...p} onAddToCart={() => addToCart(p)} />
          ))}
        </Grid>
        <MobileBottomNav items={bottomNavItems} activeItemId="home" />
        <Footer brandName="BOOST STORE" />
      </ToastProvider>
    </BoostProvider>
  );
}
```

### Admin Dashboard
```tsx
import {
  BoostProvider, ToastProvider, Sidebar, Grid, KPIWidget,
  DataTable, ActivityFeed, NotificationCenter, CommandPalette, HStack
} from '@boostengine/ui';

export default function AdminDashboard() {
  return (
    <BoostProvider defaultMode="dark">
      <ToastProvider position="top-right">
        <HStack align="flex-start" style={{ minHeight: '100vh' }}>
          <Sidebar groups={adminNavGroups} isOpen activeItemId="overview" />
          <main style={{ flex: 1, padding: '32px' }}>
            <Grid cols={4} gap={20}>
              <KPIWidget title="Revenue" value="₹14,82,900" change={18.4} changePeriod="vs last month" />
              <KPIWidget title="Orders" value="1,284" change={7.2} changePeriod="vs last month" />
              <KPIWidget title="Customers" value="892" change={-2.1} changePeriod="vs last month" />
              <KPIWidget title="Avg. Order" value="₹1,154" change={12.3} changePeriod="vs last month" />
            </Grid>
            <DataTable columns={orderColumns} data={orders} searchable pageSize={20} />
            <ActivityFeed title="Recent Activity" items={activityItems} />
          </main>
        </HStack>
      </ToastProvider>
    </BoostProvider>
  );
}
```

---

## 16. Prop Naming Conventions (AI Agent Guide)

To prevent hallucination and ensure predictable props, @boostengine/ui follows strict naming conventions:

| Pattern | Prop Names Used |
|---------|----------------|
| Open state | `isOpen` |
| Loading state | `isLoading`, `loading` |
| Disabled state | `disabled` |
| Close handler | `onClose` |
| Select handler | `onSelect` |
| Submit handler | `onSubmit` |
| Change handler | `onChange` |
| Click handler | `onClick` |
| Variants | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost' \| 'destructive'` |
| Sizes | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` |
| Positions | `'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right'` |
| Brand name | `brandName` |
| Action object | `{ label: string, onClick: () => void, href?: string }` |

---

## 17. Design Token Reference

All components respect these CSS variables when set via BoostProvider:

```
--boost-primary        Brand primary color (default: #2563eb light / #3b82f6 dark)
--boost-primary-hover  Hover state (default: #1d4ed8 light / #60a5fa dark)
--boost-bg             Page background (default: #ffffff / #090d16)
--boost-surface        Card background (default: #f8fafc / #0f172a)
--boost-text           Body text (default: #0f172a / #f8fafc)
--boost-text-muted     Muted text (default: #64748b / #94a3b8)
--boost-border         Border color (default: #e2e8f0 / #1e293b)
--boost-radius         Border radius (default: 8px)
--boost-font           Font family stack
```

**Custom Brand Colors:**
```tsx
<BoostProvider
  tokens={{ primary: '#7c3aed', primaryHover: '#6d28d9' }}
  darkTokens={{ primary: '#8b5cf6', primaryHover: '#a78bfa' }}
>
```
